newsitem.title: USA: Air Express in pact with AA Cargo.
newsitem.headline: Air Express in pact with AA Cargo.

text.p: American Airlines Cargo, a unit of AMR Corp, said Tuesday that it has signed an agreement to provide Air Express International Corp with special pricing, space allocations, automation, handling considerations and dedicated personnel worldwide, in exchange for designation as Air Express's preferred carrier.
The financial terms of the agreement were not disclosed.
American Airlines Cargo said that the companies already enjoy a close partnership, with over $35 million in joint revenues in 1996.
AEI provides multi-modal transportation, warehousing and distribution, customs brokerage and information services at 875 locations in 135 countries.
